item.title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
item.description: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. item.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
item.description: AWS Quick now has a Meta ads AI connector. item.title: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, bringing declarative, API- and console-driven configuration to the software running on Slurm cluster nodes.
